ruleSource: 6 CAR Part 35, Rule Governing the Arkansas Children's Educational Freedom Account Program

coreDefinition.text: Goods and services that are primarily instructional in nature and directly necessary for a participating student's educational program, coursework, or required educational services.

coreCategories.text: Tuition, fees, and basic supplies required for attendance by an eligible private school
Tuition and fees for academic instruction provided in a classroom setting by an education service provider, tutoring service, or other core instruction provider
Consumables common to an academic classroom such as pencils, pens, paper, erasers, and notebooks
Costs of digital learning resources, including educational software, licensed applications, and online course content
Fees for required testing, assessments, college and career readiness assessments, and approved standardized examinations
Special education services aligned to the student's individualized learning needs

coreClosedList.note: Anything not on the core list is non-core. The list is closed.

preApproval.effectiveDateLabel: expected around December 2026 (exact date and process pending from ADE)
preApproval.submissionWindowNote: Per 35-111(a)(2)(F)(i)(e), the pre-approval requirement applies to expenses SUBMITTED more than six months after the subsection's effective date. Provisional reading, editable here.
preApproval.agencyStatement: Sometime in December, preapproval will become required for the reimbursement of any non-core expense. More information on the process and which expenses require preapproval is expected later this fall.

firstYearFloor.text: In a student's first year in the program, parents may not request reimbursement for expenses dated before July 1.

criteria.text: Ordinarily used in a recognized academic, instructional, or student growth and development context.
Cost and frequency are typical compared to similar educational purchases.
Aligns with recognized curricular, developmental, or career-preparation practices.
Contributes directly to academic learning, developmental growth, or career-readiness skills.
Educational or developmental value is clear, demonstrable, and comparable to similar allowable options.
Essential to meeting a documented learning objective, developmental milestone, or career-preparation goal.
Meaningfully prepares the student for enrollment, enlistment, or employment, directly or by strengthening foundational skills.

recreationalExclusion.text: Primarily recreational, hobby-based, or personal-skill-focused expenses are not approved unless directly tied to a structured instructional program with clear academic or career-preparation objectives.

contextRequirement.text: Evaluated in the context of the student's age, grade, and developmental needs.

realPropertyExclusion.text: Improvements or fixtures to real property and general household furnishings are not ordinary and necessary, even if used incidentally for education.

extracurricular.text: Extracurricular, PE, and educational field trips: capped at 25% of the student's annual allocation and must occur within Arkansas.

transportation.text: Transportation from an approved provider: capped at 25%, at the state employee mileage rate, using the specific form from the division's website.

technologyAggregate.text: Personal devices (laptops, Chromebooks, iPads): $1,000 aggregate annual cap unless the parent demonstrates a specific private-school or higher-ed requirement, or a qualified professional deems it necessary. Dollar limits are pre-tax and pre-shipping. The Department reviews all technology for appropriateness and considers prior-year purchases to prevent duplication.

communicationDevices.exception: unless for a student with a disability unable to communicate through other means, or required as an academic accommodation specified by a clinician

technology.note: Audio equipment is excluded as a category, but listed AV learning tools (including speakers, headphones, microphones) are included when they directly serve an educational purpose.

coCurricular.text: Co-curricular courses are reimbursable only in fine arts, music, or STEM, and only if offered by a public school within Arkansas.

denialTimeline.text: The draft states a reevaluation must be resubmitted 'no less than fifteen (15) days' from the denial, and a final review requested 'no less than fifteen (15) days' from the second denial. Rendered as written.
